title: export.py templates/{service_provider_id}/{service_id}.json
description: One template's card: report.py template-summary's JSON (--service-provider-id and --service-id) for a row of templates.json, for the manifest's share_import. The report has no internal columns, so the file is exactly that report plus the release's generated_at (the manifest's) - always found (a card exists only for a listed template), so always that one template's five tables, keyed '<service provider id>/<service id>/metadata|records|supporters|served|history' with the ids unencoded, and only the share note.
